documentation.content: More than 2 % of responses from __SERVICE__ (__STAGE__) were 5xx over 5 minutes. The service is failing: read the `request failed` log lines (they carry reqId and err) and the outbox/database state. Rollback: Actions -> deploy-api -> Run workflow with the previous image SHA.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name = "__SERVICE__" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code_class = "5xx"
